on_screen_text: Tooti footi english se Fluent English tak [From broken English to fluent English] / Learn to speak English fluently / DOWNLOAD THE PW Talk APP / Sirf ’7 mein start karein [Start in just 7 rupees]
summary: A wealthy driver is surprised when a local vegetable vendor responds to an argument in fluent English. The vendor credits his skills to practicing 15 minutes daily on the PW Talk app. The ad promotes the app's affordability, starting at just 7 rupees, and urges viewers to download it.
